## Cross-platform (desktop, mobile, console, web) 3D and 2D game engine. Powerful visual editor. Support for open standards like glTF, X3D, IFC and more. Fast clean code using modern Pascal. Free and open-source.

# Comfortable visual designer and powerful code

<div class="feature-row feature-row-odd">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/impressive_castle_editor.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="421" alt="3D game in editor" />](features#_visual_editor "3D game in editor")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Visual editor](features#_visual_editor)

<div class="feature-description">

Design 3D and 2D games and user interfaces (with automatic scaling, anchors). Build and deploy the same project for multiple platforms. Integrate with various IDEs ([Visual Studio Code](vscode), [Lazarus](lazarus), [Delphi](delphi)...).

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-even">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/terrain_component_1.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="426" alt="Terrain with water and trees" />](features#_viewport_with_scenes_camera_navigation_and_other_components "Terrain with water and trees")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Components](features#_viewport_with_scenes_camera_navigation_and_other_components)

<div class="feature-description">

A lot of components to design [viewport](viewport_and_scenes) contents (3D and 2D world, using scenes, cameras, navigation, primitives, lights...) and [user interface](user_interface) (buttons, images, labels...).

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-odd">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/gltf_village_outlines.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="398" alt="Village scene with outlines in glTF from Sketchfab ( https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ftm-0970f30574d047b1976ba0aa6f2ef855 by Luis Fernandez )" />](features#_data_formats "Village scene with outlines in glTF from Sketchfab ( https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ftm-0970f30574d047b1976ba0aa6f2ef855 by Luis Fernandez )")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Lots of ways to define data](features#_data_formats)

<div class="feature-description">

Use 3D models, 2D animations, sprite sheets. Great integration with authoring tools like [Blender](blender) or shops like [Sketchfab](sketchfab) thanks to using open standards like [glTF](gltf) and X3D.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-even">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/barna29_nice_shadows.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="472" alt="Real-time water with caustics, reflections, shadows" />](features#_graphic_effects "Real-time water with caustics, reflections, shadows")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Graphic effects](features#_graphic_effects)

<div class="feature-description">

Composable shader effects, shadows, mirrors, physically based rendering, bump mapping, gamma correction...

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-odd">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/nintendo_switch_3.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="422" alt="&quot;Escape from the Universe&quot; on Nintendo Switch" />](features#_cross_platform ""Escape from the Universe" on Nintendo Switch")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Cross-platform](features#_cross_platform)

<div class="feature-description">

Target any platform (desktop: Windows, Linux, macOS, FreeBSD, Raspberry Pi, mobile: Android, iOS, console: Nintendo Switch, web). Work on any desktop platform. VR is coming as a next target soon.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-even">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/combined_fpc_delphi.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="426" alt="FPC and Delphi" />](features#_native_and_fast_code_using_modern_pascal "FPC and Delphi")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Clean and fast code](features#_native_and_fast_code_using_modern_pascal)

<div class="feature-description">

Native clean object-oriented programming language with [modern Object Pascal](modern_pascal). Fast builds, fast execution out-of-the-box.

</div>

</div>

</div>

<div class="feature-row feature-row-odd">

<div class="feature-column-image">

[<img src="images/feature_size/combined_osi_ci_logos_2.webp" class="feature-image" width="750" height="375" alt="Open-source, Jenkins, Docker, Codeberg, Woodpecker CI, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI" />](features#_build_tool_and_continuous_integration "Open-source, Jenkins, Docker, Codeberg, Woodpecker CI, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI")

</div>

<div class="feature-column-text">

## [Open source and friendly to continuous integration](features#_build_tool_and_continuous_integration)

<div class="feature-description">

Tooling friendly to continuous integration. [Command-line build tool](build_tool) and [Docker](docker) image. Ready files and documentation how to use with [GitHub Actions](github_actions), [GitLab CI](gitlab_ci), [Jenkins](jenkins), [Woodpecker CI](woodpecker) or any [other CI](ci). Engine is completely open-source and [can be used to make any (including proprietary) applications](license).

</div>

</div>

</div>
